title: Archive
description: Deleted threads, rooms, Cowork sessions and projects wait here until you restore them or delete them for good.
enabledDesc: Deleting moves things here first. Turn this off to delete straight away.
autoDeleteDesc: Archived items older than this are deleted for good when Flint starts. 0 keeps them until you delete them.
autoArchiveDesc: Threads you have not touched for this long are archived when Flint starts. Favorites are never archived. 0 turns this off.
noneDesc: Things you delete show up here.
emptyBody: {{count}} archived items will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
deleteBody: "{{title}}" will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
saveFailed: Could not save the archive settings
moveBody: "{{title}}" moves to the Archive. You can restore it from there.
worktreeKept: Its worktree stays until you delete the archived session. Unmerged work blocks that.
retentionNote: Archived items are deleted for good after {{days}} days.
retentionNever: Archived items stay until you delete them.
moveGeneric: This item moves to the Archive. You can restore it from there.
previewNote: A short read-only look. Nothing is restored or changed.
previewUnavailable: The contents could not be read. Restore the item to open it.
